name: Forsa - Vikskvarn
description: Forsa to Vikskvarn. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Fällhemmet vattenpost: Official drinking-water category. Description says there is a waterpost on a house gable along the trail.
notes: Official GPX and v2 API expose 523-point linework, while v3.2 API exposes simplified 368-coordinate MultiLineString linework. Endpoints/envelope agree.

OSM relation 15419730 is tagged Sävsjö-Vikskvarn and combines HÖ13+HÖ14 instead of sectioning HÖ14 separately. It is geometrically close for the HÖ14 subset but stale relative to official 2026 linework.

Rules lane initially reported no official potable water source found on HÖ14, but official/facility sources confirm Fällhemmet vattenpost as category Dricksvatten at 57.5094657/14.6179071. Vikskvarn water remains ambiguous because only the shelter page says nearest water is at the raststuga.

General Länsstyrelsen fire-ban page explains current fire-ban mapping and prohibition levels, while point-specific MSB API returned Inget eldningsförbud for HÖ14 coordinates on 2026-04-29 with riskIndex 3.
Sources variously use Forsa badplats, Bringetofta badplats, Forsabadet and Toftabadet for the start cluster.
Official-source lane noted a toftabadet-vindskydd context object/search result that returned 404 during access.

facilities.name: Forsa badplats, ledentré HÖ13/HÖ14
facilities.description: Official Forsa endpoint cluster with entrance, shelter, grill/fireplace, parking, bathing place and seasonal dry toilet.

facilities.name: Forsa badplats toilet
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node corroborated by Smålandsleden/Nässjö seasonal toilet text
facilities.description: Dry toilet at Forsa/Bringetofta/Tofta bathing-place. Official source says the toilet is present during 1 June-31 August.

facilities.name: Forsa badplats parking
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node, corroborated by Nässjö municipality
facilities.description: Endpoint parking at Forsa/Bringetofta badplats; Nässjö municipality says about 10 spaces.

facilities.name: Forsa / Toftaån / Forsabadet swimming
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM bathing-place node/area, corroborated by official Forsa badplats text
facilities.description: Bathing-place at the Forsa/Bringetofta/Tofta endpoint with bridge and changing-room context reported by municipal/facility sources. HaV registered bathing-water list checked on 2026-04-29 did not list this bathing place for Sävsjö; do not imply official water-quality sampling without a later source.

facilities.name: Hjälmsryds lind
facilities.description: Information/attraction marker for a large old linden at Hjälmseryd, close to the route.

facilities.name: Mattarps bokskog
facilities.description: Official nature/attraction marker for one of Europe's northern beech stands; the page also mentions a small parking place and simple rest area, but this coordinate should be treated as the POI rather than exact parking.

facilities.name: Fällhemmet vattenpost
facilities.description: Official drinking-water category. Description says there is a waterpost on a house gable along the trail. No opening hours, seasonality or recent user-flow confirmation found.

facilities.name: Rastplats near Fällhemmet
facilities.description: Official rest-place marker with sparse metadata.

facilities.name: Vikskvarn, Ledentré HÖ14/HÖ15/HÖ18
facilities.description: Official HÖ14/HÖ15/HÖ18 trail junction. Page text says HÖ14 goes south toward Forsa/Sävsjö, HÖ15 north toward Lövhult/Nässjö and HÖ18 west toward Tomtabacken and Gnosjö/Järnbärarleden. Categories include shelter, grill/fireplace, entrance, toilet and parking.

facilities.name: Vikskvarn (raststuga)
facilities.description: Rest/overnight cabin at the old mill remains with sleeping space for three people. Shelter page says nearest water for the wind shelter is at Vikskvarn raststuga, but the raststuga page itself is not categorized as drinking water. Check before importing water here.

facilities.name: Vikskvarn (vindskydd)
facilities.coordinateSource: Smålandsleden/Naturkartan official marker; OSM corroboration within a few meters
facilities.description: Wind shelter about 200 m east of Vikskvarn with room for four, table group and a simple fireplace. Official text says the nearest water is at Vikskvarn raststuga and dry toilet is about 50 m east toward Lövhult.

facilities.name: Mulltoa / torrtoa Vikskvarn
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM exact node; official text corroborates a dry toilet about 50 m east toward Lövhult; Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan toilet object corroborates nearby toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet/pit latrine at Vikskvarn. Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen text describes it as biological decomposition and organic waste only.

facilities.name: Vikskvarn parking / reserve access
facilities.description: Main reserve parking/access point at Vikskvarn, with nearby information and blue-loop access.
